limits: Catalogue source references, SHA-deduplicated artifacts, APIs and ext variants have different denominators.
A successful retrieval may contain HTML/SVG or advertise a mismatched MD5; neither is a passing engine test.
Loaded, Spider ready, valid JSON and nonempty class/list responses are reported separately.
Every captured artifact is isolated; mixed main/site reference roles are not all tested merely because its SHA ran once.
Budget skips, load timeouts and network failures remain unresolved, not permanent incompatibility findings.
Initial scanning samples one ext per API and a bounded set of home/category/detail calls; untested variants remain open.
JS/Python helper artifacts may have no standalone CSP sites; those script runtimes and dynamic helper use are outside this matrix.
Live provider responses are not replayed; no Mac/NAS same-input execution comparison or Android/ART certification is implied.

Full raw subscriptions, unrelated JARs and provider response content are removed after verification. Four explicitly documented unresolved regression JARs plus a minimal manifest are retained privately outside cache for the next fixes.
Catalog collections follow the selected default line and bounded hops; unvisited alternate collection branches and the HTML custom catalogue are not exhaustively crawled.
phaseStatus: All 115 acquired artifacts attempted in the initial bounded pass; 75 selected artifacts retested with corrected site-conversion budgets and bare-API routing; selected failure contracts diagnosed

phaseCorrections: Broad phase used csp_-only filtering and 8-second first site initialization including cold DEX conversion; these artificial timeouts are unresolved observations, not compatibility failures.
Broad main-load budget was raised from 30 to 65 seconds for later child workers. Per-artifact limits preserve the actual budget; captured config and JAR bytes stayed unchanged.
Corrected pass repeats 75 selected artifacts with 90-second load/JVM budgets, 10-second later init/call, 150-second artifact limit, up to two homes and all JAR-route API shapes.
Initial source-reference and ext-variant skips are recalculated from captured inventory and distinct actual attempts, not summed as a compatibility rate.
Both phases run a chosen loader role per SHA. Mixed-role source references are not all independently verified.

xpath.scope: Static original outer DEX class names only; encrypted/nested payloads may add classes. Existing exact configured XPath APIs are tested where reached; no cross-JAR class substitution.
